name: Birthday cake
summary: Two-tier birthday cake with frosting dots and five candles whose flames flicker, for party and celebration scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the cake rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~460 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = small rock, pop = scale in with overshoot; candle flames always flicker from f

author: krakujs
